title: Display settings
summary: How a person wants the site shown -- text 100–200 %, a colour scheme, wider spacing, images in colour, grey or hidden with their text, motion stopped, «Обычная версия» -- kept in this browser only and applied by core on every page. Replaces the legacy low-vision version (.sf-special). Promises no conformance.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

label.description: The trigger's text and the panel's name. Not set: «Настройки отображения» («Display settings»). A Russian site that is asked for the button by name writes «Версия для слабовидящих»

layout.description: disclosure: a button that opens the panel in place under it (aria-expanded), Escape closes it and the focus goes back to the button; panel: the panel stands open, with no button (a page of its own, a footer)

open.description: Whether the panel of layout disclosure is open; the button turns it, Escape closes it

show-font.description: Offer the font group: the site's font, sans serif or serif (the system's --sf-sans and --sf-serif). Off by default: the site's author turns it on

show-links.description: Offer «Подчёркивать ссылки». Off by default: the site's author turns it on. Inside a colour scheme links are always underlined

reset.summary: «Обычная версия»: every setting back to the site's own look, the kept choice removed; sends change with setting reset. refused {reason: unchanged} when nothing was changed

sf-display-settings-change.summary: A person changed a setting or chose «Обычная версия»: the fact, sent after the root shows it and the browser keeps it. Nothing is sent anywhere; a page that wants to know listens here

setting.description: The field that moved (scheme, textScale, textSpacing, images, motion, font, links), or reset.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: claiming that the site meets an accessibility standard
sending the person's choice to a server
reading aloud, fixing markup or guessing alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches the trigger and every button of the panel; Enter or Space presses it
Escape in an open disclosure panel closes it and returns the focus to the trigger
accessibility.focus: The trigger keeps the focus when it opens the panel; Escape returns the focus to it. A pressed choice keeps the focus.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-display-settings where a site offers its visitors display settings -- a school, a municipal or a public site that is asked for «версия для слабовидящих», or any site that wants a text size and contrast switch for people who do not know the browser's.
do_not: Do not say the site is accessible or compliant next to it; the panel is a comfort, the main site must meet WCAG itself
Do not add read-aloud, a dyslexia font or disability profiles around it
Do not keep the choice in a cookie or send it to a server; core keeps it in this browser
